# Iron (iron.credit)

> A concept prototype for bitcoin-backed credit: borrowing dollars against bitcoin without selling it. Loans, cards, and custody services are not available.

Iron is an early concept, not a live product. The site explains a proposed credit line secured by bitcoin, with collaborative 2 of 3 multisig custody as a design goal, and hosts a free browser-only demo. There is no verified issuer or card network partnership, no operating custody service, and no promise of approval. Rates, thresholds, and balances shown on the site are illustrative assumptions, not offers.

## Key links
- [Home](https://iron.credit/): concept overview, demo summary, and design lessons from the 2022 lender failures.
- [Concept demo](https://iron.credit/demo): simulated lock, borrow, spend, repay, and liquidation flow.
- [Credit legends](https://iron.credit/legends): research comparing the concept with historic credit companies.
- [About](https://iron.credit/about): who operates Iron and the project status.
- [Contact](https://iron.credit/contact): interest form and operator contact route.
- [Privacy](https://iron.credit/privacy): what the site collects and which services process it.
